name: Identification Reference 15 Choice
definition: Unique identifier of a document, message or transaction.

InstructingPartyTransactionIdentificatio.name: Instructing Party Transaction Identification
InstructingPartyTransactionIdentificatio.definition: Unambiguous identification of the confirmation transaction as known by the instructing party.

ExecutingPartyTransactionIdentification.name: Executing Party Transaction Identification
ExecutingPartyTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the confirmation transaction as known by the executing party.

MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.name: Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.definition: Unambiguous identification of the confirmation transaction as known by the market infrastructure.

ClientOrderLinkIdentification.name: Client Order Link Identification
ClientOrderLinkIdentification.definition: It permits order originators to tie together groups of orders in which trades resulting from orders are associated for a specific purpose, for example the calculation of average execution price for a customer.

PoolIdentification.name: Pool Identification
PoolIdentification.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

BlockIdentification.name: Block Identification
BlockIdentification.definition: Reference of the linked message at the trade/block level which identifies a centrally matched transaction.

AllocationIdentification.name: Allocation Identification
AllocationIdentification.definition: Reference of the linked message at the allocation level which identifies a centrally matched transaction.

IndividualAllocationIdentification.name: Individual Allocation Identification
IndividualAllocationIdentification.definition: Reference of the linked message at the individual allocation level which identifies a centrally matched transaction.

SecondaryAllocationIdentification.name: Secondary Allocation Identification
SecondaryAllocationIdentification.definition: Reference that can be shared across a number of allocation instruction or allocation report messages, thereby making it possible to pass an identifier for an original allocation message on multiple messages (for example from one party to a second to a third, across cancel and replace messages etc).

CommonIdentification.name: Common Identification
CommonIdentification.definition: Unique reference agreed upon by the two trade counterparties to identify the trade.

ComplianceIdentification.name: Compliance Identification
ComplianceIdentification.definition: Identification used to represent this transaction for compliance purposes.

CollateralTransactionIdentification.name: Collateral Transaction Identification
CollateralTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of a collateral transaction as assigned by the instructing party.

UniqueTransactionIdentifier.name: Unique Transaction Identifier
UniqueTransactionIdentifier.definition: Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.

LinkedIdentificationGuideline.definition: InstructingPartyTransactionIdentification, ExecutingPartyTransactionIdentification, MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentification, ClientOrderLinkIdentification, PoolIdentification, BlockIdentification, AllocationIdentification, IndexIdentification, CommonIdentification and ComplianceIdentification must not appear more than once in the message.
